digest.overview: 今日条目集中在OLED产业链的调整与需求侧变化：LG Display正式撤销P10 10.5代OLED TV线投资并整合大/中型事业部，Apple据报重新评估OLED iMac计划；同时QD-OLED游戏显示器与OLED显示器出货保持增长，MSI在2026年三季度升至OLED显示器品牌第二。另有AR眼镜成本目标与OLED堆叠材料供应链情报类内容。

news.title_zh: 三星显示在釜山G-STAR上推广QD-OLED
news.summary_zh: 三星显示在釜山BEXCO于19日至22日举办的G-STAR 2026上，与CD Projekt Red、Krafton合作设立QD-OLED游戏体验区，展出92台搭载QD-OLED面板的显示器，包括MSI 27英寸QHD MAG 272QP QD-OLED X24和三星电子32英寸4K Odyssey OLED G8。
news.why: 借助全球游戏IP与展会场景推广QD-OLED，有助于扩大高端游戏显示器面板的需求与品牌认知。

news.title_zh: LG Display撤销坡州10.5代OLED 3万亿韩元投资
news.summary_zh: LG Display于19日公告，决定不再推进坡州P10工厂10.5代OLED生产设施投资，该投资于2019年决定、原定2028年3月结束，规模为3万亿韩元。公司称新冠疫情、俄乌战争、高物价高利率等外部环境恶化，且OLED TV市场增长放缓。
news.why: 大尺寸OLED扩产计划落空，将影响上游设备与材料需求节奏，并强化面板厂以现有产能应对市场的策略。

news.title_zh: LG Display正式取消P10工厂约22.5亿美元10.5代OLED TV线投资
news.summary_zh: LG Display宣布正式取消在韩国坡州P10工厂约22.5亿美元的10.5代OLED TV生产线投资，董事会于11月19日决定不推进该2019年7月批准、此后多次延期的项目。公司监管文件称疫情、俄乌战争、高通胀与高利率、以色列-哈马斯战争等不可控事件改变市场环境，OLED TV增长放缓、LCD向OLED转换慢于预期。
news.why: 该决定确认大尺寸OLED产能扩张暂缓，产业链需重新评估设备、材料及大尺寸面板供给预期。

news.title_zh: 100/4/100挑战：显示产业能否让AR眼镜走向大众市场？
news.summary_zh: 在Bay Area SID（BASID）One Day Conference上，显示产业领袖、技术开发者和制造商围绕“100/4/100挑战”展开讨论，目标是将包含波导在内的显示子系统平均售价降至约100美元，使带显示的智能眼镜价格可负担并达到1亿台市场规模。
news.why: 若成本目标推进，将牵动AR眼镜显示方案、波导与MicroLED等微显示供应链的降本路径。

news.title_zh: OLED-Info Pro新增交互式OLED堆叠材料报告，含可自建市场预测
news.summary_zh: OLED-Info Pro发布关于OLED堆叠材料的市场报告，以交互式数据工具和PDF形式汇总已知信息，覆盖空穴注入层及其p掺杂剂、空穴传输与prime层、主体与发光体、电子传输与注入层、串联器件中的电荷产生层以及覆盖层，并列出各层供应商、已知客户及信息可靠度。
news.why: 提升OLED材料供应链透明度，为面板厂与材料商的供应关系研判提供参考工具。

news.title_zh: LG Display合并大尺寸与中尺寸事业部，郑哲东社长留任
news.summary_zh: LG Display在19日公布2027年定期高管人事与组织改编，将原有大尺寸、中尺寸、小尺寸三个事业部重组为中大尺寸和小尺寸两个事业部，以支持中尺寸产品向OLED转换并加快决策速度；郑哲东社长继续担任代表理事。
news.why: 组织整合反映面板厂向中尺寸OLED倾斜资源，可能影响IT/车载等中尺寸OLED供给与竞争格局。

news.title_zh: 报道称Apple重新考虑OLED iMac计划，或延期甚至取消
news.summary_zh: 据韩国报道，Apple正重新考虑在iMac一体机中采用OLED显示屏的计划，并与三星显示就调整开发日程进行协商，当前方向是延期观察市场，取消也在考虑之中。主因是成本：iMac销量远低于智能手机和笔记本，昂贵OLED面板难以维持价格竞争力，且2024年推出的采用双层串联OLED的iPad Pro销售未达预期。
news.why: 若OLED iMac延期或取消，将影响中大尺寸OLED面板的IT应用需求预期与面板厂客户规划。

news.title_zh: TrendForce：MSI在2026年三季度超越三星成为第二大OLED显示器品牌
news.summary_zh: TrendForce称2026年三季度全球OLED显示器出货环比增长13%、同比翻倍，主要受品牌新品和面板供应充足推动；华硕以21.7%份额居首，MSI份额从12.8%升至14.5%首次升至第二，前三季度出货与三星大致相当。
news.why: OLED显示器需求与二线品牌扩张并行，利好面板供应端出货，同时加剧品牌端竞争。

news.title_zh: LG电子晋升李相佑、白承台为社长
news.summary_zh: LG电子更换负责TV与媒体业务的MS事业本部负责人，原LG经营战略部门负责人李相佑升任社长并担任MS事业本部长兼显示器事业部长；生活家电解决方案HS事业本部长白承台也升任社长。公司于19日经董事会批准实施2027年高管人事与组织改编，人事自明年1月1日、组织改编自下月1日生效。
news.why: TV与显示器业务负责人更替，可能影响LG电子在OLED TV及显示相关业务的策略节奏。

trends: 大尺寸OLED扩产趋于谨慎：LG Display撤销10.5代OLED TV线投资，Apple据报重估OLED iMac，显示需求与成本压力受关注。
OLED显示器与游戏场景成为需求增长点：三星显示在G-STAR推广QD-OLED，TrendForce显示三季度OLED显示器出货环比增长13%。
面板厂组织与人事调整并行：LG Display合并大/中尺寸事业部，LG电子更换MS事业本部负责人，反映对中尺寸OLED与业务效率的重视。

items.title: LG Display officially cancels its $2.25 billion 10.5-Gen OLED TV line investment at its P10 fab
items.abstract: LG Display announced that it has officially cancelled its plan to invest around $2.25 billion in a 10.5-Gen OLED TV production line at its P10 fab in Paju, Korea. The company's board decided on November 19 not to go ahead with the investment, which was approved back in July 2019 and has been postponed several times since. In our spotlight on LG Display last month we wrote that the project had effectively been shelved - and now it is official. In its regulatory filing, LGD explains that since it made the investment decision, events beyond its control - the global pandemic, the Russia-Ukraine war, high inflation and interest rates, and the Israel-Hamas war - changed the market environment and made it difficult to carry out the investment as planned. Demand changed too: OLED TV growth slowed down and the transition from LCD to OLED took longer than expected, so the large OLED market has been in a slump for several years. In 2019, large and ultra-large TV panels were the main large-area OLED products, but today the fastest growth is in smaller premium products, such as gaming OLED monitors.

items.title: The 100/4/100 Challenge: Can the Display Industry Make AR Glasses a Mass-Market Reality?
items.abstract: By Sri Peruvemba, a self-described Pixelhiker who has spent nearly three decades pursuing the elusive pixel. A tech CEO, board member and advisor, Sri works with companies around the world to navigate technology, innovation and business strategy. He has been an active SID volunteer since 2002. Reach him at Sri@miinc.co . The future of augmented reality (AR) smart glasses may depend on a deceptively simple number: $100. At the Bay Area SID (BASID) One Day Conference, display industry leaders, technology developers and manufacturers came together around an ambitious goal known as the 100/4/100 challenge: $100 for 100 million. The idea is straightforward but far from easy to achieve. The industry wants to bring the average selling price (ASP) of the display subsystem, including the waveguide, to approximately $100, making display-equipped smart glasses affordable enough to reach a market of 100 million units. This is more than a cost-reduction exercise. It is a call for the display ecosystem to work together on manufacturing scale, technology roadmaps, common standards, testing and integration. The conference made clear that no single company can solve all these challenges alone.

items.title: New on OLED-Info Pro: an interactive OLED stack materials report, with a build-your-own market forecast
items.abstract: An OLED display is built from a stack of about a dozen organic layers, and each layer has its own short list of qualified suppliers. Who supplies which layer to which panel maker is rarely announced, and it changes with every new material set. Our new OLED-Info Pro market report on OLED stack materials brings together what is known, as an interactive data tool and a PDF report. The report covers the whole evaporated stack: the hole injection layer and its p-dopant, the hole transport and prime layers, the hosts and emitters, the electron transport and injection layers, the charge generation layers used in tandem devices, and the capping layer. For each one it lists the companies that make it, their known customers, and how firm the information is.

items.title: Reports suggest Apple is reconsidering its OLED iMac plans, and may delay or even cancel the project
items.abstract: Reports from Korea suggest that Apple is reconsidering its plans to adopt OLED displays in its iMac all-in-one computers . Apple is said to be in talks with Samsung Display to adjust the development schedule. The current direction is to delay the project and see how the market develops, but cancelling it altogether is also on the table. The main reason is cost. The iMac sells in much lower volumes than smartphones or laptops, and an expensive OLED panel would make it hard for Apple to keep the iMac's price competitive. Apparently, weak sales of the OLED iPad Pro also played a role. The iPad Pro, launched in 2024, adopted a 2-stack tandem OLED , but the high panel cost pushed up the device's price, and sales did not meet Apple's expectations .

items.title: TrendForce: MSI overtakes Samsung to become the second-largest OLED monitor brand in Q3 2026
items.abstract: TrendForce says that global OLED monitor shipments grew 13% in Q3 2026 compared to Q2, and doubled compared to Q3 2025. The growth was driven by new product launches from the major brands, and also by ample panel supply, which enabled second-tier and emerging brands to significantly expand their shipments. ASUS remains the market leader, with a 21.7% market share. Its shipments grew 6% from Q2, as supply constraints on its high-end 27" QHD 540Hz panels eased, and new models launched for the brand's 20th anniversary also helped. MSI climbed to second place for the first time, as its market share rose to 14.5% (up from 12.8%). MSI's growth was driven by orders for its 27" QHD monitors ahead of the holiday season, and by several new models, including 27" QHD 320Hz monitors. Over the first three quarters of 2026, MSI's shipments were roughly on par with Samsung's.

items.title: LG전자, 이상우·백승태 사장 승진
